jobs.description: Operations is the beating heart of Amazon. This key part of our business makes sure we fulfil and dispatch orders efficiently so that our customers get their items on time. About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

**AGGP2027 – Graduate Business Information Technologist **

Start date - October 2027

Are you a university graduate with the aspiration, enthusiasm, and talent to help us pioneer sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world? Every year, Airbus seeks bright minds from around the globe to fill critical roles that will shape our future.

When you begin your career with us, we don't just offer a job; we accelerate your growth through the Airbus Global Graduate development journey. This isn't a one-size-fits-all program; it's a personalized, two-year experience designed to cultivate your professional skills, enhance your business acumen, and hone your technical abilities. We place a strong emphasis on developing your leadership potential from day one. You'll gain a unique perspective on the world of Airbus while contributing directly in a specific, impactful position.

During the two years, we will take you on a soft-skill development journey, covering such areas as inclusive leadership, our Values, resilience, communication and emotional intelligence, with various in-person and virtual workshops.

Beyond your daily responsibilities and this comprehensive schedule of training, you'll join your global graduate community annually for an in-person dedicated development week. This is your chance to connect with your peers, learn directly from our seasoned leaders, and gain insights from the best in the industry.

Throughout the programme, you will be developed into an established and valuable team member from day 1. You'll sharpen your skills in an area strategically important to Airbus, gaining a deep understanding of our business – its opportunities, challenges, and needs. Most importantly, you'll have learned more about yourself and what makes you truly great. You will have demonstrated your capability and readiness to take on future leadership challenges within Airbus.

Above all, you'll have the unparalleled opportunity to do your best work in an industry that is literally reshaping how we live in our world.

If you're ready to embark on this transformative journey and unlock your full potential, apply below.

** What you will be doing**

You will be on a development journey to guide your growth into the role of Business Information Technologist and can expect to be involved in the following:

1. Analyzing business information requirements and preparing business information strategies

2. Preparing business decision regarding business information management

3. Lead projects of implementation of business information tool, systems and processes

4. Collaboration with various internal and external stakeholders

5. Understanding of project development and administrative processes

6. Supporting business development, sales and bid activities

7. Rotational placement activity will include: central services including IT infrastructure, IT network support and development, IT Security, Digital development incliding AI projects, Programme/Projects and Project Controlling, Sales & Marketing.

Your development journey will include a minimum of one rotational placement to support your growth into position, one of them (1-3 months) may be conducted at Tesat GmbH, Backnang/Germany.

At the end of the two year development programme, you will have developed into the position of Business Information Technologist.

** What we are looking for**

To be a successful applicant, you will need to demonstrate you have:

- A degree level or equivalent within Information Technology

- Recently graduated or first professional experience in the field of Business Information Technology

- Strong verbal and written communication in our local language (German) and business language (English)

- A desire to work in a collaborative team environment, focused on driving future innovation

- The ability to be self aware and a wish to be in the driving seat of your development.

Please note, we love your interest in working for Airbus but we do ask that you make only one application to the Airbus Global Graduate Programme. Take the time to decide which of our exciting opportunities is right for you and then submit an application that best represents you, your skills and experience in connection with the role you have selected.

STATEMENT: This position requires a security clearance (ITAR).

What is the recruitment process…

Online application -> Online Task Based Assessment -> Application Review (Talent Acquisition Partner & Manager) -> Virtual Assessment Centre -> Offer!

NB: Applications will close 30 September 2026 (don’t delay, apply early as some roles may close before this date due to applications received). All applications and CVs need to be in English.

Please let us know if you need us to make any adjustments. Examples of this may include (but is not exclusive to) accessible facilities and additional time for written exercises etc. Any information disclosed will be treated in the strictest confidence.

We’re doing it with energy, curiosity and sheer dedication, always learning from unique perspectives of those around us, expanding our thinking, growing our capabilities and redefining ‘impossible’. There are so many reasons to join us. If you’re hungry to build a varied and meaningful career in a community of brilliant and diverse minds to make a real difference, there’s only one choice.

Senior Principal Scientist (all genders) - Quantum Mechanics and Modeling

As a key player in our R&D digital transformation, you will leverage quantum mechanics, physics-based modeling, machine learning and AI to predict molecular properties, design and prioritize compounds across our discovery portfolio. Collaborating closely with medicinal chemists, structural biologists, biologists, and data engineers, you will drive discovery project milestones and advance our digital transformation in R&D. Your role is crucial in shaping the future of drug discovery and development through innovative digital solutions.

YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

- You advance drug discovery projects using quantum mechanics, data science, and modeling approaches to enable data‑driven decision‑making.
- You enable AI‑augmented Design‑Make‑Test‑Analyze cycles by advancing and applying methods for in‑silico compound design and characterization.
- 
Applying cutting‑edge quantum mechanics methods to advance drug development and to generate a deep understanding of molecular interactions is central to your function

- You collaborate closely with experimentalists and internal partners to identify scientific challenges and develop effective solutions.
- You lead strategic digital initiatives and actively co‑shape the R&D digital strategy.
- Working closely with the Data Science & AI unit to leverage next‑generation technologies and drive the adoption of digital solutions is a core part of your role
- You share your skills and knowledge by coaching and teaching others, demonstrating collaborative and supportive behaviors.
- You contribute to self‑directed teams that work collaboratively and align with Bayer’s leadership standards.

WHO YOU ARE

- You hold a PhD in quantum chemistry, computational chemistry, chemistry, computer science, or a related discipline, with strong knowledge of organic chemistry.
- Demonstrated success in an industry setting defines your professional track record, supported by extensive professional experience where you have utilized a diverse range of ligand‑ and structure‑based approaches, including virtual screening, docking, molecular dynamics, binding‑affinity calculations, generative design approaches, and holistic workflows
- You are proficient in quantum mechanics software such as ORCA and xTB, and you have experience in scripting, programming, and workflow automation
- You have experience working with AI‑driven DMTA loops in a pharmaceutical setting, as well as practical exposure to computational workflows that integrate AI, modeling, and chemistry
- You demonstrate high interest in managing high‑performance infrastructure and working with external IT providers
- You emb  holistic health principles and align your work with the organization’s vision as part of Bayer.
- Curiosity, creativity, and a strong passion for drug discovery are central characteristics that define you
- Fluency in English (written and spoken), with strong communication skills and the ability to present complex data clearly and effectively, round off your profile

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

This position can be filled on a full-time or near full-time (min. 80%) basis.

WHAT WE OFFER

Our benefits package is flexible, appreciative, and tailored to your lifestyle, because: What matters to you, matters to us!

- We ensure your financial stability with a competitive salary between 109.800€ and 138.500€ per year (full-time) plus a variable component and a global equity-based cash plan. Your compensation is based on your qualifications, skills, and professional experience.
- Whether it’s hybrid work models or part-time arrangements: Whenever it is possible, you will have the flexibility to work how, when and where it is best for you.
- Your family is a top priority. We offer loving company daycare centers at multiple locations, support in finding childcare, time off for the care of elderly or dependent family members, summer camps for children, and much more.
- We support your professional growth by providing access to learning and development opportunities, training programs through the Bayer Learning Academy, development dialogues, as well as coaching and mentoring programs.
